verses.text: Christ has set us free so that we can live in freedom. So stand firm, and do not let yourselves be tied up again under the load of slavery.
Listen! I, Paul, tell you this. If you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no use to you at all.
I say it again to every man who lets himself be circumcised. He must then keep the whole law.
You who are trying to be made right with God by the law have cut yourselves off from Christ. You have fallen away from grace.
But through the Spirit, and by faith, we wait eagerly for the hope of being right with God.
In Christ Jesus, being circumcised or not being circumcised means nothing. What matters is faith working through love.
You were running a good race. Who stopped you from obeying the truth?
That kind of persuasion does not come from God, who calls you.
A little yeast spreads through the whole batch of dough.
In the Lord, I am sure you will not think any other way. The person who is troubling you will be judged, whoever he is.
Brothers and sisters, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still being attacked? If that were so, the cross would no longer offend anyone.
I wish those who are upsetting you would go all the way and cut themselves off!
You, my brothers and sisters, were called to be free. But do not use your freedom as an excuse to do what your sinful nature wants. Instead, serve one another in love.
The whole law is summed up in one command: "Love your neighbour as yourself."
But if you keep biting and tearing at each other, watch out, or you will destroy each other.
So I say, live by the Spirit, and you will not do what your sinful nature wants.
The sinful nature wants what is against the Spirit. The Spirit wants what is against the sinful nature. They fight each other, so you do not do what you want to do.
But if the Spirit leads you, you are not under the law.
The things the sinful nature does are clear. They are adultery, sexual sin, impure living, and wild desires,
worshipping idols, witchcraft, hatred, fighting, jealousy, fits of anger, selfish ambition, splits, groups that take sides,
envy, murders, getting drunk, wild parties, and things like these. I warn you, as I did before, that people who live like this will not inherit God's Kingdom.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
gentleness and self-control. There is no law against such things.
Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the sinful nature, with its passions and desires.
Since we live by the Spirit, let us also keep in step with the Spirit.
Let us not be proud, or annoy one another, or be jealous of one another.
